uncited: The Ray Transformer is a neural module designed to predict Signed Ray Distance Functions (SRDF) by aggregating non-local information along a viewing ray.

Unlike standard local volume rendering, it uses linear attention to model dependencies between points ordered from near to far, building on the view aggregation of [Generalizable Radiance Fields via Transformer Attention](8996-generalizable-radiance-fields-via-transformer-attention.md).
*   Combined feature sequence: A list of tensors $\{\mathbf{c}_j\}_{j=1}^{M}$, where $\mathbf{c}_j = \text{cat}(\mathbf{f}_{v,j}, \mathbf{f}_{p,j}, \gamma_j)$.
Specific performance metrics (PSNR, SSIM) are not detailed in the provided notes.
